'''Inside the Industry''' in ''[[The Duelist]]'' #12 (September 1996, page 74) is a Game News & Updates column. Its Star Wars CCG item names [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] and [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]].<ref name="duelist12news" />

[[File:Duelist 12 page 74.jpg|thumb|right|260px|The Duelist #12, September 1996, page 74.]]

The SWCCG item sits among other Decipher and licensed-game notices on the same page, and points to the [[Of Death Stars and Empires (The Duelist)|A New Hope review]] on page 77.

<blockquote>
'''Star Wars® CCG™''' (Decipher): The first expansion, ''A New Hope'', appeared in late June; for the occasion, Decipher held a lavish party for reviewers aboard a 135-foot topsail schooner. (See review on p. 77.) ''Hoth'', the first of three 162-card expansions based on ''The Empire Strikes Back'', appears in late September (15-card boosters, $3). Decipher is preparing a national tournament structure for Star Wars.
</blockquote>
